messages.subject: Labelling Collapsed Nodes as Triangles.
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have been wondering if there would be a smarter way of labelling collapsed nodes that are displayed as triangles. I have been using something like:

(...)

# Faroe Islands ~
collapsePhylo2_2 <-
 collapsePhylo2_1 %>% collapse(node = 526, 'max', fill = "#44AA99", alpha = .7)

finalPhylo2 <- 
 collapsePhylo2_10 +
  geom_text2(aes(subset = (node == 526)), label = "Faroe Islands", fontface = "bold", family = "Helvetica", cex = 2.25, vjust = -1.6, hjust = -3.5, angle = 70, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_star(aes(subset = (node == 526)), starshape = 13, size = 1.25, fill = "#56B4E9", starstroke = .07, show.legend = FALSE) +

(...)

To generate this:




However, since I have several collapsed clades where each requires specific arguments, this approach has been very tiring. Thus, I am left wondering if there would be a more automatic way of doing this. Any help will be appreciated. 

Many thanks in advance, George.
